name: ESD
description: ESD is a safety instrumented system that drives the wellhead control panel and shutdown valves to a safe state. Offshore Norge recommended guidance assigns SIL 3 to isolation of the production/injection bore of a topside well; US OCS rules require de-energize-to-trip or supervised ESD stations. Primary source: https://www.offshorenorge.no/contentassets/adc7e1512f90400cb7fe9f314600bed6/070---recommended-guidelines-for-the-application-of-iec-61508-and-iec-61511-rev.-06.pdf
aliases: ESD (Emergency Shutdown) system with dual redundant logic and SDV valves
